description: This file defines a Swift module for discovering Tailscale gateways on macOS. It includes data structures representing gateway beacons, functions for discovering available gateways asynchronously, and internal utilities for interacting with the Tailscale CLI and network. The core logic involves probing candidate nodes obtained from Tailscale's JSON status output to identify active gateways.

classes.name: TailscaleServeGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Struct representing a discovered Tailscale gateway with display name, DNS, host, and port.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Asynchronously discovers available Tailscale gateways within a specified timeout, probing candidate nodes obtained from Tailscale status.
